## Changes

- Select Gradle and the Java compiler target from the chosen Ghidra SDK, including Ghidra 12.2.
- Verify Gradle downloads without changing files in the Ghidra installation.
- Select the required JDK in compatibility builds and report missing build tools more clearly.
- Fix Windows build-launcher quoting for project paths with spaces.
- Compare test working directories by filesystem identity, including macOS temporary-directory aliases.
- Add regression coverage for directory aliases, wrong directories and missing or duplicate fixture output.
